title: BN engine/client protocol 1.0
description: Application values of the JSON-RPC 2.0 methods and notifications. Framing is not described here. Sequence, revision and visibility invariants are checked by the engine and its reconstruction tests.

counter.description: Canonical decimal uint64 string, at most 18446744073709551615.

dim.description: Game dimension_id; empty string is the primary dimension.

pos.description: Absolute map square. Never a reality-bubble coordinate.

name.description: Player-facing name the native look shows, translated: "wooden floor" for t_floor. Absent for creatures (the entity's name) and ids the data no longer knows.

tile.description: Tile id native tilesets look up when it differs from id: corpses (corpse_<monster>), characters (player_male, npc_female), vehicle parts (vp_<id>).

looks_like.description: The looks_like chain of the game data, nearest first, in the same namespace as the sprite id. A tiled client tries the sprite id, then these in order.

subtile.description: Multitile key the native tile selection chose from the known neighbours (terrain, furniture, trap, field) or the part state (vehicle part: open, broken, else center).

rotation.description: Quarter turns the native selection chose: 0 north, 1 west, 2 south, 3 east. Vehicle parts: the facing in four directions.

facing.description: Side a creature faces; tilesets flip the sprite for left.

stack.description: Items on the square when there are several, on the displayed (last) item; the native view highlights such a stack.

light.description: Native lit_level of a visible square: 0 dark, 1 low, 2 bright only, 3 lit, 4 bright. Low light draws darkened.

overlays.description: Sprites drawn over a character, bottom first, as looks of kind overlay: id is the overlay (worn_<item>, wielded_<item>, mutation_<id>, bionic or effect), tile and looks_like the tileset ids to try in the native order. A tileset without a sprite for an overlay draws nothing.

attitude.description: How the creature regards the avatar; the native view marks monsters and NPCs with an overlay of it.

aware.description: Present when the creature is aware of the avatar (its overlay says it sees the player).

overlays.description: Sprites drawn over a character, bottom first, as looks of kind overlay: id is the overlay (worn_<item>, wielded_<item>, mutation_<id>, bionic or effect), tile and looks_like the tileset ids to try in the native order. A tileset without a sprite for an overlay draws nothing.

season.description: Season of the calendar; tilesets name seasonal sprites with a _season_<name> suffix.

pane_id.description: The pane or tab this entry belongs to. Tab rows of a tabbed menu have none.

editor.description: A value the client can set directly with `fill` (field_id is this choice's id) instead of cycling it natively. `bool` takes `true` or `false`, `select` one of `values[].id`, `integer` and `float` a number within `minimum` and `maximum`, `text` a string of at most `max_length` (-1: unbounded). `value` is the current value in the same form.

unit.description: Present when positions are overmap terrain squares (the overmap is open), not map squares.

overmap.description: The native overmap window as drawn, row-major. Each cell is [glyph, foreground, background] with curses color indexes 0-15 (0 black, 1 red, 2 green, 3 brown, 4 blue, 5 magenta, 6 cyan, 7 light gray, 8-15 their bright forms). Positions are overmap terrain squares.

path.description: The planned travel route, nearest square first.

tiles.description: Only for a client that said `tiles` in hello. `cells[row][col] = [tile, rotation, subtile]`: the overmap_terrain tile id, quarter turns and multitile key (empty for a plain tile). `looks_like` lists, per tile id, the ids to try next.

banner.description: Fixed-width lines drawn above the menu, with color tags: the main menu's title art and version line.

interaction.description: choices holds at most the first 200 rows, fewer when they would be too large; read the rest with bn.interaction.choices from offset = choices.length. choice_total is the full count.

view.description: The squares of the avatar's level a map click selects: the native terrain window, which follows the avatar.

changes.description: Applied in member order: coverage, view, cells, forgotten, entities, gone, then avatar/environment/route/interaction replace.

data_message_logged.description: One line of the native message log. A repeat of the last line is published again with the same id and a higher count and replaces it.

tile.description: Tile id the native tiles draw the explosion with.

data_combat_text_shown.description: Floating text at a square, as the native scrolling combat text: one or two colored segments.

tiles.description: The client draws tiles, so the engine adds tile ids where it has them (the overmap).

view.description: The squares of the avatar's level a map click selects: the native terrain window, which follows the avatar.

route.description: The native auto-move route a map click planned and not yet confirmed: the squares to walk, nearest first, ending at the clicked square. Empty or absent when nothing is planned.

viewport.description: Map cells the client can show, as columns and rows of the native terrain window.
